name: SDF Ray Marching with Grid Lookup
aliases: Camera ray intersection via ray marching
GPU Raytracing of SDF via 3D Texture
definition: A GPU-based ray marching algorithm that samples a 3D Signed Distance Function (SDF) grid to find the first intersection point of a ray with the zero-level set (surface). It uses linear interpolation to evaluate the SDF at arbitrary points within the grid bounds.
summary: SDF Ray Marching with Grid Lookup is a GPU algorithm that finds ray-surface intersections by using linear interpolation to evaluate a 3D signed distance function grid, enabling precise detection without fixed step constraints.
